dedupe_keys.name: katrisk catastrophe models and hazard data flood surge wind convective storm wildfire earthquake

description: KatRisk builds catastrophe risk models and hazard data for insurers, reinsurers, government agencies and financial institutions. Its peril suite covers inland flood, storm surge, tropical cyclone wind, severe convective storm, wildfire and earthquake, with correlation between perils and regions and climate change scenarios for sensitivity tests. The inland flood model uses physically based hydraulic and hydrologic simulation of fluvial and pluvial flooding, with 10 m terrain data in the United States, Canada, Australia and New Zealand and 10 to 30 m data in Europe, Central America, Mexico and the Caribbean. Coverage: per the hazard data page, inland flood and tropical cyclone wind worldwide, storm surge for the United States and Australia, and severe convective storm and wildfire for the United States. Format and access: hazard data with return period values and risk scores, and the SpatialKat, SoloKat (API), Perilfinder and Orchestra software; sold by licence after a demo. Licence: proprietary; terms and prices were not read. Caveats: the models are built for insured losses, and their vulnerability functions and event sets were not read; the product pages are marketing text. KatRisk states it acted as risk calculation agent for 2.2 billion dollars of FEMA/NFIP catastrophe bonds. Simulation uses: flood, wind and wildfire hazard layers at return periods for exposure and resilience studies of buildings and infrastructure. Related records: Verisk's models (model-verisk-catastrophe-risk-models-touchstone) and Moody's RMS (platform-moodys-rms-catastrophe-models) are competing vendors.
